description: Python's validate_rust_image_receipt on <case>/image with the receipts {image, preparation}. Each case writes the complete image's tree with its edits (text, symlinks or empty folders) and patches the complete image's receipts (member paths set or removed). value true is a passing check; refusal and os_error carry Python's text, the case directory written <root>.
